scope: CLI run entry for autonomous BMLGGUF with explicit CheckedExactF32 and mandatory materialization budget

fixture.construction: Independent one-layer Llama GGUF binary from crates/runtime/tests/support/symbolic_fixture.rs

contracts: Explicit policy and budget load the converted model and generate through the symbolic causal profile
Container magic identifies BMLGGUF independently of extension; missing explicit policy returns an actionable error
Missing paired options, invalid policy, zero budget and conflicting --bml/--weights return argument errors
Insufficient materialization budget returns an error before generation and preserves the file
Corrupt payload is rejected without generation
Existing compiled-model generation uses the same shared loop and remains covered by the workspace gate
limitations: Numeric activations and F32 KV follow the declared symbolic causal RPN profile, not exact rational inference.
The CLI uses default ReadLimits; max-evaluated-weights bounds weight expansion, not total process RSS.
No real-model conversion/inference or full mutation-campaign completion is claimed.
